quest.title: Nora, Run!
quest.description: Nora wants to play on top of the statue, but Sister Grace forbids her to...
quest.rewards_formatted: Dandelion Seed x2, Dandelion Seed x2, Delicious Flaming Red Bolognese x1

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Hmm, what to do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: See the Anemo Archon statue? Now, look up there, the really high bit... where the archon's hands are.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: I wanna go play up there... But Grace won't let me climb the statue.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Please can you go and talk to Grace for a bit? Don't let her look this way. I climb really quickly, I'll be up there in no time...

choices.text: I guess I can do that...

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: Yay, thanks!

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: Go and distract Aunty Grace for a minute, I'll go up right now...

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Nora! No!

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Phew, I look away for one second and she starts bothering you. I do apologize.

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: Whyyy! I just wanna play up there for a little bit...

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: No means no! Your father would not approve either.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: And you — please refrain from indulging her! People would be just as worried about you if you did something so dangerous.

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: It'll be fine, I'm really good at climbing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's enough for today.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Okay... Time to have a rest.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Wah...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you want to do up there?

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Aunty Grace says that if you want to tell someone a secret, you just need to tell it to a dandelion then throw it to the wind... The Anemo Archon will carry the dandelion seeds and the secret you told it to the person you want.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: And the higher you throw it into the wind from, the faster your message will get there...

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: This one time, Glory got an adventurer to climb up the statue and throw some dandelion seeds into the wind for her. Just a few days later, Godwin wrote her a letter back!

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: I have a secret to tell Daddy, and I already got a dandelion.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: But Aunty Grace won't let me do it. She says that I can go back and live with Daddy when I've grown up.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: I wish there was a way to grow up faster... I'm trying as hard as I can, but I'm still so short...

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Oh yeah— I always see you gliding around in the city. Can you teach me? How do you do it?

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: Hee-hee, yay! I'll just stand by and watch, I'm sure I'm allowed to do that.

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: No way! Aunty Grace would go mad if she saw me doing that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm gonna take a breather...

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Don't be too long.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Oh, Nora...

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Yes, for a number of reasons her mother is... away from home. In the meantime, I'm taking care of her.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: I also care for several other children who need someone to look after them. It's part of my duty as a sister.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: It's like I suddenly got a whole new family of children. They're good kids, and they get on well with Glory, too.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Timmie's the one I've looked after longest. He's even started calling me Mommy...

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Patton is her father. His incessant drinking caused huge problems in the home.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: The Church and the Knights of Favonius both gave him a number of warnings, but he would not change his ways. In the end, it was Master Diluc who took action.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Believing that Patton was in no shape to look after Nora, Sister Victoria put her under the care of the Church while Patton takes some time out to reflect.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: But when Nora grows up, the excuse we keep giving her that "Daddy is busy with work and needs to be left alone..." It's going to wear thin.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: And even the Anemo Archon's dandelions are limited in their reach.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: You flew there in {ChallengeCurrValue10} minute(s), that's amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Do you wanna go again? I bet you could go even faster...

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: And I'll give you a prezzie if you do!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll do it again.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Yay! I'll be watching you the whole way.

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Wooow! When I'm bigger, will I be able to glide like that?

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: Woohoo! I'm gonna grow up as fast as possible, then, when Daddy's finished his work, he can play with me!

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: But maybe it's easier for grown-ups.

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: Thank you. Here, this is a present for you. It's some treasure that I collected in secret.

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: Quick, take it... Also, don't tell Aunty Grace!

choices.text: After you've got your gliding license, sure!

response.speaker: Nora
response.text: Gliding license? What's that? It sounds complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Nora
dialogues.text: Hmm, I thought it looked cooler last time... Did you glide the same way?
